model.name: merge.applyAllFromSide
model.description: One of the 3 modes of the 'Apply All' popup: bulk-apply one side into CENTER so CENTER matches the LEFT file (Local wins) or the RIGHT file (Repo wins) - resolves conflicts too. Method applyAllFromSide(side) (NEW 5fa11089), DISTINCT from the existing applyAllNonConflicting (Method 2b630af1 / Impl 91c452ae, non-conflicting-only, KEPT as the 3rd mode). Rides R30.35 addSide 843d79d4. Tron ruling: ADD side-wins, do NOT replace.
